LESSON PLAN CRE ACTIVITES
 Week: Lesson:
 SCHOOL GRADE DATE TIME ROLL
 TWO
STRAND/THEME/TOPIC: THE CHURCH
SUBSTRAND/SUB-THEME/SUB-TOPIC: PRAYER
Specific lesson learning outcome.
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be to recite the first 4 lines of the Lord’s pray as a way of communicating
to God.
KEY INQUIRY QUESTION (s)
 How do we pray?
 Core competencies Values PCIs
  Critical thinking  Trust Self-awareness
  Problem solving  Humility Self-esteem
  self-awareness  Faith and hope
  Decision making
LEARNING RESOURCES
Bible.
C.R.E activities Learner’s Book Grade 2 pg. 101-104.
C.R.E Activities Teacher’s Guide Grade 2 pg. 62-64.
ORGANIZATION OF LEARNING
Learners to work in pairs or groups.
INTRODUCTION
Learners to sing a familiar song.
LESSON DEVELOPMENT (Assessment as learning)
 Step 1: Learners to read Matthew 6:9-10.
 Step 2: Guide learners to recite the first 4 lines of the Lord’s Prayer.
 Step 3: Encourage learners to pray/say simple prayers.
SUMMARY
We should pray always.
CONCLUSION (Assessment of Learning)
Learners to recite the Lord’s Prayer
EXTENSION OF ACTIVITIES
Learners to participate in prayers during school assemblies and participate in bible in club activities.
REFLECTION ON THE LESSON/SELF-REMARKS

 SCHOOL GRADE DATE TIME ROLL
 TWO
STRAND/THEME/TOPIC: THE CHURCH
SUBSTRAND/SUB-THEME/SUB-TOPIC: THE HOLY SPIRIT
Specific lesson learning outcome.
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be to state the promises Jesus gave to his disciples, and desire to have faith
in God.
KEY INQUIRY QUESTION (s)
 What are the works of the Holy Spirit on your life?
 Core competencies Values PCIs
  Critical thinking  Hope Self-awareness
  Problem solving  Unity Self-esteem
  self-awareness  Courage
  Decision making  love
LEARNING RESOURCES
Bible.
C.R.E activities Learner’s Book Grade 2 pg. 105-108.
C.R.E Activities Teacher’s Guide Grade 2 pg. 64-66.
ORGANIZATION OF LEARNING
Learners to work in pairs or groups.
INTRODUCTION
Learners to sing a familiar song .
LESSON DEVELOPMENT (Assessment as learning)
 Step 1: Learners to read Acts 1:4 and Acts 2:3-4.
 Step 2: Explain to the learners the term “promise” using the conversation between Mark and his parents on page
 105 of the learner’s book.
 Step 3: Describe Jesus promise of a helper to the believers.
 Step 4: Explain the work of the Holy Spirit to the learners.
SUMMARY
Review the lesson and make summary.
CONCLUSION (Assessment of Learning)
Learners to ask and answer questions.
EXTENSION OF ACTIVITIES
Learners to sing a song about the work of the Holy Spirit.
